paper.title: Pooling and Drift in Delayed Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Delayed bandits with intermediate observations, known action-to-state map P
unmapped: an intermediate state S_t ~ P(.|A_t) from a finite state space is observed immediately; the loss is delivered after a fixed delay d
state-sufficiency: E[X_t | past, A_t, S_t] = theta_t(S_t), with oblivious state-loss means theta_t in [0,1]^|S| and stochastic losses given the states
the learner knows the action-to-state matrix P
the learner knows a budget V^- (or V) on the cumulative effective dimension, used to tune eta
settings.definition_quote: There are $T$ rounds, $K$ actions, a finite state space $\Sset$, a known action-to-state matrix $P$, and a fixed known delay $d$ ... the learner draws $A_t$ from a distribution $x_t$, observes $S_t\sim P(\cdot\mid A_t)$ at once, and receives the delayed outcome only at time $t+d$, encoded as a loss $X_t\in[0,1]$ ... the state-loss means $\theta_t\in[0,1]^{|\Sset|}$ are oblivious

settings.name_in_paper: Delayed bandits with intermediate observations, stale-loss oracle m_t = c_{t-d} and drift budget E_2 (lower bound)
unmapped: an intermediate state S_t is observed immediately; loss delivered after fixed delay d
the learner additionally receives the stale action-loss vector m_t = c_{t-d} before acting
the instance has drift E_2 = sum_t ||c_t - m_t||_inf^2 <= E (drift budget)
the learner knows the action-to-state matrix P
settings.definition_quote: For Theorem~\ref{thm:lower} only, the learner also receives the stale action-loss vector $m_t\triangleq c_{t-d}$ before choosing $A_t$ ... We measure how misleading $m_t$ is by $\etwo=\sum_t\|c_t-m_t\|_\infty^2\le T$

symbols.V_minus: budget fixed in advance with sum_t (v_t - 1) <= V^- always; v_t is the effective dimension (chi^2 mutual information + 1)

tuning: eta <= 1/(e(d+1)), optimised as in the proof using V^-, d, T, K

source.label: thm:m1
source.quote: Let $P$ be known and $(\theta_t)$ oblivious, and fix in advance any $V^-$ with $\sum_t(v_t-1)\le V^-$ always. Then \textup{\textsc{State-EXP3}} with any $\eta\le1/(e(d+1))$ satisfies $\Ex[R_T]\le\sqrt{2(3.3V^-+2dT)\log K}+e(d+1)\log K+d$.

results.notes: Statement says 'any eta <= 1/(e(d+1))' but the proof derives the bound with optimised eta (min of A/eta + B eta under the cap). Regret defined via c_t = P theta_t, i.e. pseudo-regret. V^- = (vbar-1)T is admissible. O(K) per round.

symbols.V: budget fixed in advance with sum_t v_t <= V always (e.g. vbar*T <= |S| T)

source.label: thm:sexp3
source.quote: Let $P$ be known and $(\theta_t)$ oblivious. Pick before the run any fixed number $V$ with $\sum_tv_t\le V$ always. Then \textup{\textsc{Interleaved-State-EXP3}} at the matching learning rate satisfies $\Ex[R_T]\le\sqrt{2(d+1)V\log K}$.

results.notes: Runs d+1 copies in rotation. Horizon: V typically scales with T.

symbols.V_g: budget with sum_t v_t(g) <= V(g) for the grouped sensor
symbols.delta_sum: sum_t delta_t(g), the within-group spread of state losses under grouping g

conditions: grouping map g fixed in advance

source.label: thm:rep
source.quote: Under the hypotheses of Theorem~\ref{thm:sexp3}, running on $g$ with $\sum_tv_t(g)\le V(g)$ gives $\Ex[R_T]\le\sqrt{2(d+1)V(g)\log K}+2\sum_t\delta_t(g)$.

results.notes: Interleaved algorithm run on merged states g(S_t).

symbols.E_drift: drift budget: E_2 = sum_t ||c_t - m_t||_inf^2 <= E_drift

conditions: learner is handed the exact stale losses m_t = c_{t-d}
instance fixed in advance with E_2 <= E_drift

source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: Fix $T$, a delay $1\le d\le T/2$, a drift budget $\mathcal E\le T/4$, and $1\le J\le\min\{K-1,|\Sset|-1\}$. Every algorithm, even one handed the exact losses from $d$ rounds ago, meets some instance fixed in advance with $\etwo\le\mathcal E$ on which $\Ex[R_T]=\Omega(\sqrt{d\,\mathcal E\min\{1+\log J,\,T/d\}})$.

results.notes: Construction uses deterministic P with private states for J drifting actions and Rademacher block signs.

source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: Without that help, and if $K\le T$, the best regret any algorithm can guarantee is $\Omega(\sqrt{KT}+\sqrt{d\,\mathcal E\min\{1+\log J,\,T/d\}})$, up to constants.

results.notes: The sqrt(KT) term is taken from Esposito et al. 2023 Thm 5.1; terms come from different hard instances. Setting s2 includes oracle in unmapped, but this branch is without the oracle.
